mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_record (stat_date, usage_type, model, call_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) VALUES (CURDATE(), #{usageType}, #{model}, #{callCount}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count = call_count + VALUES(call_count), prompt_tokens = prompt_tokens + VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = completion_tokens + VALUES(completion_tokens)
